beats.say: Nextcloud has shipped a desktop app for Nextcloud Office, bringing its collaborative document editing suite to the desktop.
On June 9, 2026, we released the first production-ready version of Euro-Office, a sovereign collaborative office suite developed and governed in Europe.

With the Nextcloud Office Desktop app, you can edit files locally without an internet connection. In this article, you’ll learn about the app’s features, how to install it on Windows, macOS and Linux, and how to co-edit files with your team through Nextcloud Hub.
